items.title: SC lists on Oct 26 journalist's plea alleging Rahul Gandhi pushed her during Oct-12 march
items.summary: The Supreme Court (CJI Surya Kant + Justice Joymalya Bagchi) agreed on Friday to list on Oct 26 an interlocutory application by journalist Richa Parashar alleging Rahul Gandhi grabbed and pulled her while she covered the Oct-12 opposition march to the SC registry, and that his security then pushed her, leaving her fallen and later hospitalised. The Congress denies the claim. Sr Adv Gaurav Bhatia mentioned the application in advocate Digant Mishra's petition seeking guidelines on demonstrations within court premises; the CJI also confirmed that notice has been issued in all connected matters.

items.title: DCP Sachin Sharma warns of legal action if 5 PM Tiranga march defies Sec 163
items.summary: DCP New Delhi Sachin Sharma urged protesters to abide by the law ahead of CJP's 5 PM 'Lehra Do Tiranga' march at Connaught Place, saying Abhijeet Dipke has been informed that Sec 163 BNSS is in force in the New Delhi district and has been made aware of its implications, including during the festive season; he added that police will take 'whatever legal action is appropriate' against violations.
